_doc: The vehicles of the town (round 13, scripts/sim/vehicles.gd). name; seats (people it carries: a party on foot is at most three); speed (the road's hours are divided by it); burn (fuel for each hour driven); cargo (what the party's loot is multiplied by); hp (its condition, 0 to 100: a bad trip takes some, a vehicle at 0 is lost); art: the picture in assets/objects the gate's parking draws, w and h in tiles (sized to the picture's own shape so that it is not squashed). A place of the town may hold one (`vehicle` in town.json, one of these ids).
